## Workload

Kofi Asante completed 940 reads during 480 hours of grading activity. This represents a rate of 2.0 reads per hour. The workload was reviewed in relation to the time recorded, with the review focused on the volume completed and the consistency of the grading process.

The current session pattern was retained following consideration of the workload information. No change to the established arrangement was recorded.

## Quality

A total of 76 reads were checked as part of the quality review. Agreement between the grading completed by Kofi Asante and the review undertaken was 69.7 per cent.

The review was completed by Priya Anand. The findings provide a record of both the workload completed and the level of agreement identified through the checking process.
